trans-unit.note: Detailed Description: Informative text displayed in the TYPO3 "About" module or help section to explain the module's full purpose (1-2 sentences). Use "description" from TYPO3 14 on.
MShort Description: Tooltip text shown when hovering over the module icon in the main menu (1 concise sentence). Use "short_description" from TYPO3 14 on.
Module Title: Visible navigation link text in the main backend menu (max. 1-2 words). Use "title" from TYPO3 14 on.
